Anna — thanks for the clear asks and the charter. Attached is a focused MAP workbook and a short set of test vignettes intended to be executable by your PM/Eng in the trial. High level summary below and a proposed cadence for the three-week evaluation.

Summary (one-paragraph):
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference performance and qualitative output for the CareSync triage assistant with objective pass/fail checks and two executive-level KPIs (latency and FTR — first-time-right resolution on a 500-sample test set).

Proposed success criteria (measurable):
- Latency: median inference latency < 200ms at sustained 100 qps (measured over 10-minute windows)
- Quality: FTR >= 82% on a seeded 500-sample evaluation set (samples provided by CareSync)
- Security: All PHI-containing payloads proxied through your VPC connector; audits enabled and logs retained for 30 days

Hard exit gates (fail -> pause engagement):
1) Latency violation: median latency > 250ms for 30+ consecutive minutes during load tests
2) Data boundary breach: any evidence of PHI leaving the customer VPC or non-compliant logging
3) Severe availability: > 1% request error rate sustained for > 15 minutes during test windows

Acceptance tests (owner / pass criteria):
- Smoke: single-request generation with seeded prompt (CareSync) — pass if response contains required triage tags (Camila owns)
- Load: sustained 100 qps for 10 minutes using the 500-sample set — pass on latency and error-rate thresholds (Redwood ops owns)
- Quality regression: run the 500-sample set and compute FTR; pass if >=82% (CareSync product owns run; Redwood produces scorecard)

Proposed timeline / cadence:
- Week 0 (prep): exchange datasets, finalize VPC connector details, sign evaluation addendum
- Week 1: smoke + small-scale functional runs, remediate infra/config issues
- Week 2: load tests + quality runs, perform one interim review with execs
- Week 3: final verification, evidence package delivered, sign-off meeting

Attachments included: care-sync-map-v1.xlsx (MAP workbook with task owners & dates), eval-test-vignettes.json (example inputs and expected outputs)

Next steps: I copied Camila (solutions) to scope the smoke and load playbook. Marissa (sales manager) will confirm the evaluation addendum language for procurement. If that looks reasonable I can drop a one-page SOW addendum for procurement/legal.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
